# r/denvernuggets (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** Where the Denver Nuggets stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

The Denver Nuggets in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #1 Nikola Jokić 97.8
- #20 Jamal Murray 63.4
- #81 Aaron Gordon 53.7
- #87 Cameron Johnson 53.5
- #112 Christian Braun 51.4
- #171 DeMar DeRozan 45.9
- #199 Marvin Bagley III 44.2
- #265 Tyus Jones 40.4

GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
